title: GTA 6 Fan Creates Ultimate Custom In-Game Snacks for Release Week
description: Get ready for launch week! A creative GTA 6 Reddit user has crafted a stunning collection of custom real-world in-game snacks and drink brands like Ecola, Sprunk, and Bean Machine Coffee.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Ultimate GTA 6 Fan Prepares Custom In-Game Snacks and Drinks for Launch Week

As the hype surrounding Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster continues to build, fans are finding incredibly creative ways to channel their excitement. Recently, a dedicated user on the r/GTA6 Reddit community, /u/chebke, shared a fun and immersive project: a complete lineup of custom-made, real-world versions of in-game snacks and beverage brands specifically tailored for the game's release week.

### Bringing the Vice City World to Life

The fan revealed that putting the collection together was an absolute blast. The custom items span a wide array of fictional brands featured across the GTA universe, relying heavily on the comprehensive snack and drink brand lists provided by gta.wiki. 

The impressive lineup includes:

*   **Beverages**: Ecola, Sprunk, FizzAzz, Flow Water, Rainé, and Bean Machine Coffee
*   **Snacks and Treats**: Jesters, Quads, Phat Chips (using the classic logo from Trailer 1, while the updated logo was spotted in the extended look), Chedda Catfish, Tiny Frank (a cookie brand), and EZ Nuts

While the alcohol branding in the game scored a solid 10/10 in design, the creator noted that they skipped making liquor items simply because they aren't personally into alcohol. They also skipped a Schweppes parody due to a lack of detailed logo references. 

### Community Creativity and Dedication

This isn't the creator's first rodeo when it comes to expressing fandom through arts and crafts; a year ago, they also painted a custom themed mug. For fellow fans looking to host their own ultimate GTA VI launch night party, the user shared downloadable Ecola and Sprunk label links directly on Reddit.

It is worth noting that these fan projects are entirely community-driven creations (unconfirmed by Rockstar Games). Nevertheless, they highlight the incredible impact of Rockstar's world-building and how deeply the fictional consumer brands resonate with the player base.

## Editor's Take

It's moments like this that remind us why the GTA community is one of the most passionate in gaming. Long before launch day arrives, fans are already inventing traditions to celebrate together. Crafting fictional sodas and snacks turns a digital release into a tangible, shared experience. We can only imagine how many Ecola cans will be cracked open worldwide when GTA 6 finally drops.
